new_candidates.body:
### Proposal

Currently the command builder does not include arguments for visualization and I think it will be useful to include it. 

The command argument should include the last part "--viz newton_gl"

uv run isaaclab play --rl_library rsl_rl \
  --task Isaac-Reorient-Cube-Shadow \
  physics=newton_mjwarp presets=asymmetric \
  --viz newton_gl

### Motivation

This will make it easier for people to see the policy results after training for those that are unfamiliar with all the cmd arguments. 

### Alternatives
N/A

### Build Info
- Isaac Lab Version 3.0

### Additional context
N/A 

### Checklist

- [x] I have checked that there is no similar issue in the repo (**required**)

### Acceptance Criteria

Add the criteria for which this task is considered **done**. If not known at issue creation time, you can add this once the issue is assigned.

- [ ] When the command builder output include the argument "--viz newton_gl"
new_candidates.title: [Proposal] Command Builder Should Include Argument for Simulation Visualization
